jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering – Network Automation and AI Solutions
jobs.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is seeking a highly strategic and technically accomplished Director, Software Engineering – Network Automation and AI Solutions
to lead the transformation of how we design, engineer, operate, and support our network infrastructure through automation, artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and modern software engineering practices.

This leader will be responsible for defining and executing the technology strategy across network automation, OSS platforms, operational tooling, AI-enabled engineering workflows, network correlation, inventory management, ticketing integration, and network triage systems. The Director will provide architectural leadership and technical direction for software engineering teams developing scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency, service quality, and customer experience across Zayo's network operations and engineering organizations. The ideal candidate combines deep telecommunications and network operations expertise with modern software engineering leadership, leveraging AI, automation, and orchestration technologies to accelerate delivery, reduce operational complexity, and enable a more proactive and intelligent network operating model.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the strategic roadmap for network automation, OSS modernization, and AI-driven operational transformation.
Lead and develop software engineering teams responsible for network automation, OSS platforms, and operational tooling.
Establish architectural standards, engineering best practices, and scalable solutions across monitoring, inventory, correlation, ticketing, and network management systems.
Drive adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve network operations, service delivery, and engineering workflows.
Identify, prioritize, and deliver high-impact automation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, service quality, scalability, and customer outcomes.
Provide technical leadership for the design, development, integration, and support of automation platforms and enterprise OSS applications.
Partner with business and technology leaders to align automation investments with strategic objectives and operational priorities.
Establish engineering metrics, performance standards, and KPIs to measure delivery excellence and business impact.
Lead operational transformation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and accelerate incident detection and resolution.
Collaborate across Engineering, Network Operations, Product, Security, Architecture, and IT to drive enterprise-wide automation and technology initiatives.

Additional Responsibilities

Evaluate emerging technologies, AI platforms, LLM frameworks, and automation capabilities to support innovation and continuous improvement.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on automation, software engineering, AI strategy, and operational modernization.
Influence enterprise technology decisions through technical expertise, business acumen, and organizational leadership.
Foster a high-performance engineering culture focused on innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and customer success.
Communicate technical strategies, roadmap progress, and business outcomes effectively to technical and executive audiences.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
Minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in software engineering, network automation, OSS development, network operations, or related technical disciplines.
Minimum of five (5) years of engineering leadership experience managing software development or automation teams.
Hands-on experience with Cisco Crosswork Network Controller (CNC) and Cisco Network Services Orchestrator (NSO), including network automation, orchestration, and service lifecycle management.
Proven experience leading large-scale automation and operational transformation initiatives.
Strong expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, and enterprise application development.
Hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript, and modern development frameworks.
Experience designing and implementing AI-enabled automation solutions in production environments.
Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, SSL, HTTP(S), SSH, routing, switching, and network management principles.
Experience with network monitoring and management technologies including SNMP, Syslog, telemetry, and event management systems.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Telecommunications, fiber network, carrier, or large-scale infrastructure industry experience.
Experience with IBM/Tivoli Netcool, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Splunk, or similar OSS and operational platforms.
Knowledge of network inventory, service assurance, fault management, and operational support systems.
Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, AI orchestration frameworks, agent-based architectures, and enterprise AI adoption strategies.
Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, APIs, microservices, and modern integration platforms.
Experience building AI governance frameworks and responsible AI operating models.
Knowledge of network engineering, service delivery, and customer-facing operational processes.

Success Measures

Increased automation adoption across network engineering and operational workflows.
Reduction in manual operational effort and process cycle times.
Improved network reliability, service quality, and incident resolution performance.
Successful delivery of strategic OSS modernization and AI transformation initiatives.
Measurable operational savings and productivity improvements.

Estimated base salary range: $142,600 - $219,400 USD/annually.

Work Authorization Requirement:
This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Zayo will not provide, transfer, or assume sponsorship for any employment visa or work authorization for this position now or in the future.

The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.

Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.

The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.

Benefits, Rewards & Wellness

Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan
Generous paid time off policy including paid parental leave

Zayo is an equal opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact us.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

As part of the application, hiring, onboarding, and/or employment process, Zayo or its affiliates, partners, and vendors may collect, store, and use biometric identifiers and biometric information (collectively, “Biometric Data”), such as fingerprints, facial geometry scans or other unique biological characteristics. Zayo uses CLEAR1, a third-party identity verification service, to verify applicant identity during the hiring process. CLEAR1 may collect Biometric Data, including facial geometry scans and/or other biometric identifiers, to authenticate your identity. Biometric Data will be retained pursuant to CLEAR1’s policies, which can be found here: https://www.clearme.com/clear1-credential-policy-crp. Zayo will not sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from any applicant's or employee's Biometric Data. By proceeding with your application, you acknowledge this disclosure. Prior to any collection of Biometric Data — including through CLEAR — you may be presented with a separate consent form and asked to provide your written authorization in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA), the Texas Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act (CUBI), and other applicable biometric privacy statutes.

jobs.title: Director, Mobile Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the role:

Lead a world-class Mobile Platform Engineering organization at ServiceNow that powers AI-native enterprise experiences across iOS and Android. This leader will hire exceptional mobile and AI talent, establish an AI-forward engineering culture, and deliver scalable mobile platform capabilities for purpose-built enterprise applications.

Lead Mobile Platform Strategy and Execution

Own the technical roadmap for enterprise mobile platform capabilities across Android and iOS.
Establish and run on-call rotations, incident response processes, and a blameless postmortem culture that drives reliability improvements.
Define reusable frameworks, SDKs, and platform patterns that accelerate application development across multiple product teams.
Partner with Product, Design, AI, Infrastructure, and Business leaders to deliver differentiated mobile experiences.
Drive excellence in performance, reliability, security, scalability, and operational rigor across the mobile platform.

Architect Enterprise Mobile Experiences

Design mobile platform capabilities for purpose-built enterprise applications across customer service, field service, operations, and productivity workflows.
Lead architecture for synchronization, offline-first experiences, notifications, inbox experiences, real-time interactions, and workflow execution.
Ensure applications perform reliably in low-connectivity and offline environments while meeting enterprise-grade security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
Create seamless experiences across mobile clients, AI services, platform capabilities, and enterprise workflows.

Provide Technical Leadership

Lead critical architecture reviews and complex technical decisions across mobile, platform integration, and application layers.
Own the mobile build and delivery pipeline, including CI/CD reliability, build speed and test infrastructure.
Establish standards for observability, telemetry, mobile performance benchmarking, release quality, and production readiness.
Mentor Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, and senior technical contributors.
Advance mobile innovation through AI-enabled workflows, modern development practices, and strong engineering fundamentals.

Qualifications

12+ years of software engineering experience with significant experience leading mobile engineering organizations (Android and iOS).
3+ years leading engineering managers or multi-team organizations.
Strong technical depth in mobile architecture, APIs, distributed systems, cloud-native services, networking, security, data synchronization, and MAM/MDM enterprise integrations.
Track record building and scaling enterprise-grade mobile applications or mobile platforms used at large scale.
Experience managing Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.

Specific AI Skills We Value

Experience building or integrating generative AI, LLM-powered experiences, AI agents, or copilots into mobile or enterprise applications.
Working knowledge of RAG, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and AI safety principles.
Familiarity with AI platforms and frameworks such as Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or comparable ecosystems.
Understanding of on-device AI patterns, small language models, speech or vision models, real-time inference constraints, and mobile latency tradeoffs.
Experience applying AI to engineering productivity, including code generation, test generation, automated review, incident analysis, or quality automation.
Ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, secure, enterprise-grade mobile workflows.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $199,900-$348,400, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs.

Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

jobs.title: Director, Go to Market Engineering
jobs.description:
What We Need

Corpay is hiring a hands-on Director, Go-to-Market Engineering to lead the strategy, delivery, and ongoing evolution of production software, data products, and AI-enabled workflows for Sales and Marketing. The role sits within Corpay's Sales & Marketing organization and partners with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Product, Data, and Technology. Candidates must translate complex commercial priorities into scalable technical strategies, align stakeholders around priorities, test solutions with users, deploy them reliably, and quantify the results.

This leader will combine first-party and third-party data to improve account prioritization, seller productivity, qualified pipeline, time to productivity, and multi-product adoption.

The Director owns the Go-to-Market Engineering agenda from problem definition through technical design, deployment, adoption, and business measurement. The role provides both strategic leadership and deep technical direction, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, measurable, and aligned to commercial priorities.

This leader will guide a team with complementary capabilities across software and data engineering, including pipelines, APIs, enterprise integrations, and trusted data models, as well as applied data science and AI, including predictive modeling, experimentation, and large language model applications. The Director must maintain sufficient technical depth to establish engineering standards, make informed architectural decisions, and guide the delivery of production-quality solutions end to end.

How We Work

As Director, Go-to-Market Engineering, you will be expected to work in an office environment, alongside your colleagues, full time in our Buckhead, Atlanta office.

Role Responsibilities

The responsibilities of the role will include:

Technical Strategy and Leadership
Set the technical vision, multi-year roadmap, architecture, and delivery priorities for Go-to-Market Engineering in alignment with Sales and Marketing objectives.
Lead, mentor, and develop engineering talent while establishing clear goals, accountability, delivery practices, and engineering standards.
Partner with senior business and technology leaders to prioritize investments, manage dependencies and risks, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and measurable business impact.
Establish performance measures that connect technical delivery to commercial outcomes, including seller productivity, pipeline quality, adoption, and revenue impact.
Software and Data Engineering
Lead the design, development, and operation of batch and real-time data pipelines that integrate CRM, marketing automation, website, intent, engagement, product, transaction, partner, and third-party data.
Establish and govern trusted account and contact data models, including identity resolution, lead-to-account matching, deduplication, enrichment, lineage, and automated data quality checks.
Provide technical direction for scalable APIs, enterprise integrations, data platforms, and production software that enable reliable commercial workflows.
Set standards for code quality, testing, security, observability, operational support, and documentation across the Go-to-Market Engineering portfolio.
Applied Data Science and AI
Guide the development and operationalization of predictive models, experimentation frameworks, and AI-enabled workflows that improve account prioritization, seller productivity, and customer engagement.
Ensure AI and machine learning solutions are designed with appropriate governance, data quality, measurement, and change-management practices.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend pragmatic applications that create measurable commercial value.
Cross Functional Partnership and Delivery
Translate commercial problems into clear technical requirements, solution options, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
Build strong partnerships with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data, and Technology leaders to drive adoption and ensure solutions meet user needs.
Oversee solution testing, deployment, user enablement, and post-launch measurement to ensure reliable delivery and sustained business impact.
Go-to-Market Strategy and Leadership
Set the vision and multi-year roadmap for Go-to-Market Engineering based on the highest-priority opportunities across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success.
Work in a high-performing team that combines engineering discipline with a strong understanding of the customer journey, demand generation, lead management, and sales execution.
Partner with senior business and technology leaders to prioritize initiatives, sequence investments, resolve dependencies, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and business impact.
Establish clear goals and operating practices that hold the team accountable for adoption, seller productivity, pipeline quality, conversion, sales cycle improvement, and revenue impact.
GTM Systems and Process Enablement
Improve how data and work move across the commercial funnel, from audience and account identification through lead capture, enrichment, scoring, routing, nurture, seller follow-up, and customer handoffs.
Create a trusted view of accounts and contacts by improving matching, deduplication, enrichment, data quality, and ownership across Marketing and Sales.
Connect CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, website, partner, product, and transaction data so commercial teams can identify the best opportunities and act on them quickly.
Translate Marketing and Sales needs into practical tools, workflows, and decision support that improve campaign execution, account prioritization, seller preparation, pipeline management, and cross-sell.
Establish standards for reliability, security, documentation, and ongoing support so commercial teams can trust, adopt, and consistently use the solutions the team delivers.

Experience And Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (MBA or advanced degree often preferred)
A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in software engineering, data engineering, data science, AI/ML, or a closely related technical field.
At least 7 years of hands-on technical experience designing, building, and supporting production-grade software, data products, platforms, integrations, or AI-enabled solutions.
At least 3 years of progressive leadership experience leading engineers, technical teams, major delivery initiatives, or technical strategy in a complex, cross-functional environment.
Demonstrated ability to balance strategic leadership with sufficient technical depth to guide architecture, engineering standards, delivery quality, and operational reliability.
Experience partnering with commercial functions such as Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, or Product to deliver measurable business outcomes.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively at all levels of the organization and in a matrixed environment
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to work in ambiguous, high-pressure environments
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Proven track record of delivering measurable business results

About Corpay

Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.

At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.

jobs.title: Director of Security Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Role

Abnormal AI protects organizations from the most sophisticated email and collaboration attacks using behavioral AI. Security is not a bolt-on at Abnormal; it is core to the product we sell and the trust our customers place in us. Our security organization operates a commercial cloud environment and a separate FedRAMP-authorized environment, and we are pursuing increasingly rigorous federal authorizations as we grow.

We are hiring a Director of Security reporting to the CISO and leading the Security Engineering organization. You will build and scale high-performing security teams, own major security programs end to end, and operate autonomously in the CISO's absence, including representing security to executive leadership, customers, and auditors.

This is a role for a deeply technical leader with a software engineering background who has grown into people leadership. You have built security teams from the ground up, you write and review code and architecture when it matters, and you believe the best security organizations earn their influence through partnership rather than policy enforcement.

Our Security Philosophy

We run security the way the best engineering-led companies do:

Security reduces toil. Our job is to make the rest of the company faster and safer at the same time. If a control adds friction without reducing risk, it is a defect.
Paved paths, safe by default. We invest in guardrails, golden paths, and secure-by-default infrastructure so the easy choice is the secure choice. We prefer preventing classes of problems over chasing individual findings.
Partnership over gatekeeping. Security succeeds only through deep collaboration with engineering, IT, and business teams. We embed with builders, we ship alongside them, and we take on their constraints as our own.
Engineering-grade rigor. We treat security problems as engineering problems: automated, measurable, code-reviewed, and continuously improved.

If the security cultures that value freedom and responsibility, context over control, and guardrails over gates resonate with you, you will feel at home here.

What You Will Do

Serve as deputy to the CISO: act with full authority in the CISO's absence and represent the security organization to executives, customers, and regulators.
Lead, coach, and grow managers and senior engineers across Security Engineering and Security Operations.
Own the security engineering roadmap: cloud security architecture (AWS-first), detection and response, identity, vulnerability management, and secure-by-default platform investments.
Drive cross-functional programs with Engineering, IT, and Product, from AI security governance to data perimeter controls to federal compliance initiatives.
Set and defend engineering standards for the security organization: everything as code, automated where possible, measured against outcomes rather than activity.
Build hiring pipelines and raise the bar on every hire; own performance management, promotion cases, and succession planning within your teams.
Translate technical risk into business terms for the executive team and board, and translate business priorities into a coherent security strategy.

Must Haves

10+ years in security or software engineering, including 4+ years managing security teams, ideally including managers of managers or equivalent scope.
A genuine software engineering background: you have shipped production software, and you evaluate security solutions the way an engineer would.
A proven record of building and scaling high-performing security teams, with alumni who would work for you again.
Deep technical fluency in cloud-native environments: AWS organizations and multi-account governance, Kubernetes, identity and access, detection engineering, and modern SDLC security.
Demonstrated cross-functional leadership: you have earned the trust of engineering leaders and shipped security outcomes through their teams, not around them.
Strong written communication: you produce decision-ready documents and can drive alignment asynchronously.
Executive presence: comfortable presenting to C-level leadership, customers, and auditors without preparation from the CISO.

Strong Signals

You are currently a security engineering manager or senior manager at a fintech, high-growth startup, or forward-leaning enterprise, and you are ready for broader scope.
You have built paved-path or secure-by-default platforms that measurably reduced both risk and developer friction.
Experience with compliance-driven environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) without letting compliance define the security program.
Experience securing AI/ML systems or governing AI adoption at scale.
You have operated in environments where security headcount was scarce and automation was the only way to scale.

Why This Role

You will inherit strong teams, an executive staff that treats security as a first-class function, and a CISO who wants a true partner rather than a lieutenant. The scope is broad, the autonomy is real, and the ceiling on this role is defined by what you take on.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:

$214,200—$308,000 USD

A note on AI in our process:

Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

GE HealthCare is seeking a Director of Engineering, Architecture to lead the architecture and technical strategy for our next-generation Imaging Fabric platform. This platform enables AI-powered medical imaging, real-time visualization, and enterprise-scale performance across on-premises, edge, and cloud environments.

This role is responsible for defining enterprise architecture, driving platform modernization, and enabling the integration of AI capabilities into imaging products used by healthcare providers worldwide. The successful candidate is an accomplished technology leader with deep expertise in enterprise software architecture, high-performance distributed systems, and medical imaging platforms.

This is an applied AI architecture leadership role, focused on integrating AI capabilities into production imaging solutions rather than developing machine learning models.

Job Description

Role Description

Define and execute the enterprise architecture strategy for the Imaging Fabric platform.
Lead the design of scalable, secure, and high-performance imaging solutions across on-premises, edge, and cloud environments.
Drive platform modernization through cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and performance optimization.
Partner with Product Management and Engineering leaders to translate business strategy into scalable technical solutions.
Enable the adoption of AI-powered imaging capabilities including visualization, intelligent streaming, workflow optimization, and image analysis.
Establish architecture standards, technical governance, and engineering best practices.
Mentor senior architects and provide technical leadership across global engineering teams.
Drive cross-functional collaboration to deliver reliable, enterprise-grade healthcare platforms.

Must-Have Qualifications

10+ years of experience designing and leading enterprise-scale software architectures.
Proven experience building high-performance, distributed systems in healthcare, medical imaging, or similarly complex technology environments.
Deep understanding of medical imaging platforms, including DICOM, PACS, and clinical imaging workflows.
Experience architecting scalable solutions across on-premises, edge, and public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
Strong knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, Kubernetes, containerized applications, and cloud-native architectures.
Experience integrating AI capabilities into enterprise software platforms, including AI inference, image analysis, or intelligent workflow optimization.
Strong programming background in C++, Python, Java, or Go.
Demonstrated success leading senior technical teams, influencing architecture across organizations, and driving enterprise technology strategy.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Medical Imaging, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Medical Imaging, Computational Imaging, Computer Graphics, or a related field.
Experience with advanced medical imaging technologies including rendering, visualization, image streaming, and large-scale imaging datasets.
Knowledge of GPU computing (CUDA or equivalent), parallel processing, and high-performance computing.
Experience with AI-enabled imaging capabilities such as image segmentation, image enhancement, intelligent streaming, or predictive data loading.
Familiarity with modern visualization techniques, scientific imaging, and enterprise healthcare platforms.
Experience mentoring senior architects and leading technical transformation across globally distributed engineering organizations.

Why GE HealthCare

At GE HealthCare, you'll help shape technologies that clinicians rely on every day to diagnose disease, guide treatment, and improve patient outcomes. You'll work alongside world-class engineers, architects, and product leaders to build scalable healthcare platforms that will define the future of medical imaging.

The AI Garage for Investments & Wealth is seeking a Director, AI / Machine Learning Software Engineer to provide senior technical leadership in establishing and operationalizing enterprise-grade AI Operations (AI Ops) capabilities. This role is critical to ensuring that AI applications, agentic solutions, models, data pipelines, and supporting platforms can be deployed, governed, monitored, and sustained in production with the reliability, security, and operational rigor required in a highly regulated financial services environment.

This leader will serve as the bridge between Engineering and Production, providing oversight across the full AI lifecycle. The role is responsible for defining AI Ops standards, implementing automation and observability frameworks, establishing operational controls, and driving best practices for production support, resiliency, governance, and continuous improvement.

Define and lead the AI Ops strategy for AI Garage for Investments & Wealth.
Establish standards, frameworks, and best practices for deploying, monitoring, and supporting AI/ML solutions in production.
Provide technical leadership across the full AI lifecycle, from development through deployment, governance, and ongoing operations.
Drive automation of AI/ML pipelines, model deployment, monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes.
Build and enhance observability frameworks to ensure visibility into model performance, data health, system reliability, and operational risks.
Partner with engineering, platform, infrastructure, data, risk, and production support teams to ensure AI solutions meet enterprise standards for resiliency, security, and compliance.
Establish operational controls and governance processes for AI applications, models, and data pipelines.
Lead efforts to improve production reliability, scalability, and efficiency for AI-powered applications and platforms.
Influence architecture decisions to ensure AI solutions are designed for operational excellence in a regulated environment.

Mentor and guide senior engineers and technical teams in AI Ops, SRE, and production support best practices.

Strong expertise in cloud platforms, distributed systems, automation, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks for complex production environments.

Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to bridge engineering and production teams effectively.

Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.
Familiarity with governance, risk, and compliance considerations for AI/ML applications.
Experience supporting agentic AI solutions, modern ML platforms, and large-scale data pipelines.
Knowledge of security, reliability, and performance engineering best practices for AI platforms.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to play a pivotal leadership role in shaping the AI operational backbone for Investments & Wealth. You will help define how AI solutions are reliably brought into production, managed, and scaled, while influencing enterprise-wide standards and advancing innovation in a critical growth area.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Manager, Alexa Connections
jobs.description:
Description

Come help us build the worlds most personal and proactive AI assistant with Alexa+. With over 600 million Alexa devices now out in the world, the latest advancements in generative AI have unlocked new possibilities—enabling us to reimagine the personal communication experience in our pursuit of making customers' lives better and easier every day.

Our vision at Alexa Connections is to build the most trusted AI assistant that helps our customers gets things done and creates moments of joy. We build delightful Communication Experiences for connecting within customers household (Announcements, Drop-In's), with their community (Video Calling, Phone Number calling, Emailing, Texting, Sharing) and with AI for improved productivity (Calendar/Task extraction). We also build real time multi-modal AI primitives that help serve customers across Amazon portfolio of devices that include Alexa, FireTV, Ring etc. Generative AI is deeply embedded in our product development life cycle across all our experiences and primitives.

If you’re passionate about building magical experiences for customers, while solving complex technical problems, then this role is for you. You will operate at the intersection of large language models, real time communications, voice and graphical user interfaces, and mixed reality to deliver delightful experiences for end customers.

Come join us to invent the future of how billion's of customers will connect with and through their virtual AI assistants.

Key job responsibilities

As the Sr Manager of Software Development, you will be responsible for leading a large yet scrappy team that invents and simplifies daily. Your team will build the delightful consumer facing UX, Alexa's communication systems, interface with third party telecom infra and optimize Alexa's LLM architecture to help Connections achieve its vision. You will coordinate the implementation efforts between internal and external partners. You will make appropriate trade offs to optimize time-to-market with long term tech evolution. You will optimize your organization to maximize the value for our customers. You will clearly communicate strategy, optimize roles & responsibilities, and achieve desired outcomes. You will influence the forward looking strategy for Alexa+, our portfolio of devices and services. You will be an integral part of Alexa Connections Executive team.

About The Team

Alexa Connections is a highly distributed team across six Amazon approved sites. We have industry experts in real time communications, computer vision, media processing, consumer facing UX. We imbibe Amazon's Leadership Principles, hold each other accountable and have lots of fun while building a product billions of our users love. You will constantly help us foster a culture where everyone can do their best work.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of engineering experience
5+ years of engineering team management experience
Experience partnering with product or program management teams
BS degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related technical field
7+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience
Track record of leveraging data to build cloud and/or edge based AI models, prompt engineering and tuning GenAI LLMs
Experience communicating with senior business, product, design and engineering executives; inspiring teams on a delightful technical strategy

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
Deep knowledge of real time communications and collaboration, networking, computer vision, multi-modal AI technologies
Experience with global telecommunications infrastructure and carrier relationships
Understanding of global data and telecom regulations and compliance

About The Company

America is under sustained cyber attack. Our adversaries infiltrate our networks, steal our IP, and degrade the digital infrastructure that modern life runs on. They’ve learned—correctly—that those attacks rarely produce consequences.

Twenty was founded to change that, by making our adversaries think twice before they attack us. Our vision is American and allied primacy in cyberspace—a future where they cannot contest us, deterrence is assured, and the free world remains secure.

Founded in 2024, Twenty Technologies (www.twenty.io) industrializes offensive cyber operations for the U.S. and its allies. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Twenty has raised $168M from Khosla Ventures, Accel, Caffeinated Capital, Friends & Family Capital, Point72 Ventures, General Catalyst, and In-Q-Tel.

Mission | On Site
| Full Time | U.S. Citizenship Required / No Active Clearance Required

Role Summary

You will build and lead the engineering organization that gets Twenty's software into the environments where our customers use it, keeps it secure and running there, and keeps it accredited. That covers infrastructure and the delivery path into customer environments, security engineering for our products, site reliability engineering at headquarters and at customer sites, and a new accreditation program for our products on government networks.

You will decide what gets built first, hire the people who build it, and lead them directly while the organization grows, often in disciplines where they know more than you do. You'll need enough technical depth to lead those specialists credibly, the judgment to make sound decisions in areas you haven't worked in yourself, and the organizational instincts to grow a new function.

Our product engineering teams are your peers and your main customers. You succeed by giving them tools, defaults, and a delivery path they want to use, not by doing their work for them. You'll partner closely with the VP of Engineering on org strategy and hiring, and with the product engineering leaders on what this organization provides them.

What You'll Do

Build the organization: decide what to stand up first, how the work is divided into teams, and when to add management capacity, in partnership with the VP of Engineering.
Hire across infrastructure, security, reliability, and accreditation: set the bar for each discipline, run a structured process, and close strong candidates in a cleared hiring market.
Lead and develop senior engineers directly, as well as the managers you add as the organization grows.
Own the delivery path from a developer's laptop to a running instance, including instances we can't reach interactively: build, signing, packaging, install, upgrade, and rollback in customer environments.
Take over infrastructure work that product teams are doing today, and build a team resilient enough to keep owning it.
Own the operation of our products in our cloud and at customer sites, including incident response across the boundary between them.
Lead security engineering for our products: design review, secure defaults, vulnerability management, and detection, working with our managed detection and response provider.
Stand up and own an accreditation program for our products, through a dedicated lead who reports to you.
Communicate clearly to senior leadership on progress, risks, and the tradeoffs you're making.Who You Are
You're equally comfortable in a data-model review, a customer conversation, and a 1:1—you bring the same rigor to each.
You think in systems: data pipelines, marketplace incentives, interfaces, trust boundaries, team structure, and delivery dependencies—not just tickets.
You can turn ambiguous operational needs into clear engineering problems, measurable product outcomes, and executable plans.
You hold a high bar without creating drag—you know when to push and when to get out of the way.
You execute: you drive projects to completion, make decisions under uncertainty, and actively resolve ambiguity before it becomes drift.
You communicate crisply with engineers, product partners, operators, vendors, and leadership without losing technical truth.
You bring calm, structured decision-making to sensitive, fast-moving problem spaces where data quality, privacy, and security matter.

Must Have

You have 8+ years of professional experience across software, infrastructure, site reliability, or security engineering.
You have 5+ years of engineering management experience, including leading multiple teams or a team spanning more than one discipline.
You've built or substantially rebuilt an engineering function: set its scope, hired its people, and grown it into a team others rely on.

About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
to lead the technology capabilities that keep digital products, cloud platforms, and internal teams secure, reliable, and productive.

This role oversees cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, bot mitigation, corporate IT, and helpdesk support, while providing architectural leadership across cloud platforms, networking, identity, observability, and operational tooling. This position spans both internal employee technology and the production infrastructure supporting high-traffic, customer-facing applications.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, SRE, production operations, corporate IT, helpdesk, and bot mitigation, establishing ownership, operational standards, service-level objectives (SLOs), escalation procedures, and performance metrics.
Develop managers, technical leads, and IT staff through coaching, career development, and building a culture of accountability, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement.
Build quarterly and annual infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business priorities, growth, security, reliability, and cost, partnering with engineering, product, data, marketing, finance, HR, legal, and executive leadership.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure, primarily within AWS.
Provide architectural leadership across cloud services, applications, APIs, networking, identity, databases, storage, observability, and integrations while establishing architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and technical review processes.
Partner with engineering to improve deployment safety, performance, and readiness, driving automation, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
Lead capacity planning for growth and demand spikes, eliminating single points of failure, undocumented systems, manual processes, and single-source dependencies.
Ensure production and nonproduction environments are properly separated, secured, and monitored, reviewing new systems for architectural fit, supportability, security, and total cost of ownership.
Establish and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), SLOs, availability targets, and error-budget practices for critical systems.
Improve observability through centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, application performance monitoring (APM), and actionable alerting.
Lead major incident management, coordination, executive communication, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking to improve mean time to detect, respond, and recover.
Develop and test backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and establish sustainable on-call practices.
Own strategy and tooling for bot mitigation, scraping protection, automated abuse prevention, and traffic-quality management using technologies such as Cloudflare, DataDome, web application firewalls (WAFs), rate limiting, CAPTCHA alternatives, and device fingerprinting.
Partner with cross-functional teams to distinguish malicious automation from legitimate customers, search engines, partners, and approved AI crawlers, establishing monitoring and response procedures.
Oversee internal IT services and helpdesk support, establishing service-level expectations for response times, resolution times, user satisfaction, and backlog reduction.
Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning, access management, asset recovery, and device inventory.
Standardize endpoint configuration, encryption, patching, and endpoint detection across laptops, collaboration platforms, productivity software, and telecom services.
Establish consistent identity and access management practices across corporate and production systems, implementing role-based access, least privilege, multi-factor authentication (MFA), periodic access reviews, and secure administrative account handling.
Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, audits, vendor reviews, incident readiness, and applicable privacy requirements in partnership with legal and security teams.
Manage infrastructure, security, IT, telecom, monitoring, and support vendors, handling evaluations, contract reviews, renewals, licensing, service level agreements (SLAs), and budget management.
Improve cloud cost visibility through tagging, allocation, forecasting, tool consolidation, and contract optimization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.

Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, contracts, departmental budgets, and cloud costs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, architecture, and tradeoffs to executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Cloudflare, DataDome, or comparable bot-management and web application protection platforms, including leading bot mitigation or traffic-quality programs.
Experience with AWS services, containerized environments, infrastructure as code, centralized logging, and APM tools (such as AppDynamics).
Experience supporting large-scale consumer subscription, public-record, data-as-a-service, advertising, or ecommerce platforms.
Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure, transitioning systems from external vendors, and consolidating cloud accounts or IT services.

Improved availability, performance, and stability of customer-facing platforms.

You will own the quality, margin, and strategic direction of our technology services engagements from pre-sale through delivery, while unifying a cross-functional team of architects, engineers, and platform experts into a single, scalable practice.

It requires a leader who can move between executive strategy and hands-on execution when it counts, drive cross-functional alignment without formal authority, and bring clarity and momentum to complex, evolving client engagements spanning martech platform configuration to web and email engineering. The successful candidate will serve as a key liaison between Operations, Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise IT to ensure OT systems remain secure, reliable, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. This position leads a team of OT professionals while driving strategic initiatives focused on cybersecurity, risk management, infrastructure modernization, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance.

The Senior Manager will provide technical leadership and subject matter expertise for large-scale capital projects, mergers and acquisitions integrations, operational expansions, and cybersecurity initiatives while ensuring adherence to industry best practices and recognized frameworks such as NIST, ISA/IEC 62443, API 1164, and NERC-CIP where applicable.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

Develop and execute the enterprise OT strategy in alignment with Energy Transfer's operational, cybersecurity, and business objectives.
Establish long-term roadmaps for OT infrastructure modernization, lifecycle management, system resiliency, and cybersecurity enhancement.
Partner with executive leadership, operations management, engineering teams, and Enterprise IT to drive OT technology adoption and innovation.
Lead OT governance programs, standards development, and enterprise-wide policy implementation.
Serve as the primary escalation point for critical OT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and operational issues.

Operational Technology Management

Provide overall leadership and management of the OT organization supporting multiple operating regions and facilities.
Lead teams responsible for PCN infrastructure, industrial networking, virtualization environments, Windows server platforms, and OT cybersecurity technologies.
Establish performance metrics, service level objectives, and continuous improvement initiatives for OT operations.
Manage vendor relationships, support agreements, licensing programs, technology contracts, and strategic partnerships.
Ensure standardization of OT architectures across facilities while maintaining operational flexibility and reliability.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Energy Transfer's OT Cybersecurity Program.
Collaborate with Enterprise Cybersecurity teams to implement cybersecurity frameworks and standards across industrial environments.
Establish cybersecurity governance, vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, and disaster recovery programs for OT systems.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, internal controls, and industry-recognized security frameworks.
Champion cyber risk assessments and mitigation strategies for critical operational assets.

Infrastructure Reliability & Operational Excellence

Drive high availability and reliability initiatives for OT systems supporting 24x7 operations.
Oversee backup, recovery, business continuity, and disaster recovery programs across all OT environments.
Ensure proper lifecycle management and supportability of OT hardware, software, operating systems, and networking infrastructure.
Lead root-cause analysis efforts for critical incidents and oversee implementation of corrective actions.
Support operational readiness activities for new facilities, expansions, and infrastructure upgrades.

Capital Projects & Engineering Support

Serve as OT technical authority for major capital projects, facility expansions, and strategic initiatives.
Ensure all OT and cybersecurity requirements are incorporated throughout project planning, design, construction, commissioning, and startup phases.
Participate in technology evaluations, architecture reviews, and project approval processes.
Provide technical guidance on industrial networking, system integration, virtualization, cloud connectivity, and emerging OT technologies.

Leadership & Talent Development

Build, mentor, and develop high-performing OT professionals.
Establish succession planning and employee development strategies.
Foster a culture of safety, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Promote cross-functional collaboration among Operations, Engineering, Cybersecurity, and IT teams.
Lead organizational change initiatives and technology transformation programs.

Required Education & Experience

Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience supporting Operational Technology, Industrial Control Systems, Process Control Networks, or Industrial Cybersecurity environments.
Minimum 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical teams and enterprise-scale OT programs.
Demonstrated experience leading multi-site OT infrastructure environments supporting critical operations.
Strong knowledge of industrial networking, server infrastructure, virtualization, systems architecture, and cybersecurity best practices.
Proven experience managing complex projects, budgets, vendor relationships, and technology roadmaps.

Align technology execution to business outcomes
Driving roadmaps including moving environments onto a companywide standard
Own communication and change management for large initiatives
Ensure that key initiatives are prioritized, executed, and ROI measured effectively
Tracking project progress and financials against approved roadmap
This role requires the ability to collaborate with and influence multiple stakeholders to develop and deploy robust enterprise-wide technology projects to meet long term business goals.

The Senior Director plays a pivotal role in driving the organization’s technology strategy and ensuring alignment with business goals. This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned strategic leader to influence the long-term direction of technology at a high level while working closely with executive leadership to achieve business success.

Focus Areas

Technology Excellence– Exemplify the organization’s commitment to excellence, building trust and credibility among stakeholders and customers
Transformation Enabler - Foster a culture of experimentation and collaboration within the organization, driving continuous improvement, agility, and competitive advantage in with a cost effective and reliable environment leveraging Gen AI and automation
Capability Builder - Support the organization's technological needs by delivering holistic roadmaps to deliver the required ROI
Customer Champion - Prioritize customer-centric technology projects and track the appropriate ROI

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision:

Partner with technology leadership and other executives to define and communicate the long-term technology roadmaps aligned with the company’s business goals and market opportunities
Lead planning efforts to ensure that technology investments are future-proof, scalable, and capable of supporting business growth and transformation
Identify emerging technologies and industry trends, advising leadership on their potential impact on the business and shaping the organization’s technology roadmap
Technology Roadmap & Planning:
Develop and maintain comprehensive, technology road maps that align with both current and future business needs
Drive the planning and prioritization of key technology initiatives across the organization, ensuring that resources are optimally allocated and aligned with strategic goals
Work with business units to understand their strategic objectives and translate those into actionable technological plans and solutions

Portfolio Management

Oversee the portfolio of technology projects, ensuring alignment with business outcomes and proper resource allocation
Evaluate project performance, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and adjust course as necessary to ensure timely delivery and alignment with overall strategy

Use insights from reporting and metrics to refine strategy and drive continuous improvement across the organization

Lead the development of integration plans that align acquired technologies with the broader organizational strategy

Communication And Change Management

Lead change management activities required to roll out and adopt technology projects to ensure effective return on investment
Drive communication to ensure stakeholders across the portfolio of companies are kept aware of the latest developments and buy into the technology project impacts
Required Skills & Abilities:
Forward-thinking strategist skilled in devising and operationalizing a technology strategy across multiple operating entities
A storyteller who translates technical concepts into business terms and articulates the value of technology investments to stakeholders
Commitment to upholding the highest standards of integrity and accountability in managing the organization’s technology
Flexible and adaptable to respond to evolving technology challenges and organizational needs
A change agent that fosters a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, encouraging experimentation, and adapting to evolving circumstances and environment
An authentic and tenacious leader who leans in to partnering with peers and is a collaborative team leader who is steadfast in leading by example
Exemplary organizational skills coupled with proactive initiative-taking meticulous attention to detail, and adept time management, flourishing in a dynamic and rapidly evolving environment
Acts as a culture ambassador, living our organizational values
Experience Managing Onshore and Offshore Teams: Proven ability to lead and manage both onshore and offshore teams, ensuring seamless collaboration and execution of technology projects. This includes strategic oversight, cross-cultural leadership, communication and coordination, performance management, resource allocation, and risk management.

Experience driving internal development teams and external partners to deliver business outcomes using agile methodologies
Strong understanding of technology project lifecycles, portfolio management, and best practices in delivering large-scale technology initiatives

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering Top 1200 West
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About The Role

Skydio is seeking an experienced Solutions Engineering leader to join our team as Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering for the SLED Top 1200. The Top 1200 is the band of agencies immediately below Majors, and it is where the Drone as First Responder motion moves from bespoke to repeatable, so the work rewards a leader who can build patterns and hold a team to them. The segment runs as one national team today, and depending on growth it may later split into East and West regions; building the team so that split is clean when it comes is part of the job.

This is a remote role. Travel of approximately 30% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.

This role reports to the Director, Solutions Engineering – SLED.

About The Team

The SLED Solutions Engineering team is the technical arm of Skydio's state and local go-to-market motion. We sit between the agency and the product: turning operational problems into program designs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are used, integrated, and flown at scale.

The team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion, site assessment quality, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.

Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Key Account Leaders, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of Public Safety sUAS programs.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Lead the team

Hire, onboard, coach, and retain your team, with clear ownership and coverage across the territories in your segment, and develop people beyond the seat they are in.
Set the bar for technical quality — demos, trial plans, site assessments, and customer-facing documentation that hold up in front of a chief, a sheriff, or a city council.
Own capacity across your segment. Decide where Solutions Engineering time goes, say no when it needs to be said, and make the tradeoffs visible to leadership.

Drive technical wins

Own the technical win across the Top 1200 nationally, pairing one Solutions Engineer to each Key Account Leader.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point on critical pursuits, deployments, and customer issues. Jump in and work the problem yourself, and be in the field when it matters.
Partner with Sales leadership on pipeline, forecast, and account planning, and on the land-and-expand motion that turns a first dock into a citywide program.

Own the Top 1200 problem set

Turn what works in Majors into something repeatable at volume. Demo standards, site assessment quality, and trial design are yours to systematize, and to structure so the segment can split regionally without relearning the motion.
Own site assessment quality as a performance measure. Solutions Engineers are the DRI for verifying a dock location before deployment, and the quality of the resulting installation reflects on the team.
Hold the bar on proofs of concept: structured deployments tied to an active opportunity with measurable operational value, not casual evaluations.
Guide integration and airspace strategy — CAD and dispatch, video and evidence management, streaming platforms, BVLOS approvals, waivers, COAs, and docked operations.
Maintain command of the public sector procurement path, including cooperative contracts, grant funded programs, and public sector buying cycles.

Represent the customer inside Skydio

Be the aggregated voice of the customer to Product and Engineering. Turn field observations into prioritized, defensible requirements rather than a list of one-off asks.
Build the enablement content, reference architectures, and reusable technical assets that let the team scale, and maintain first-hand product knowledge through frequent hands-on use.

What Makes You a Good Fit

5+ years of relevant technical experience, including time in a customer-facing technical role (solutions engineering, field engineering, or applications engineering).
1+ years leading a technical team, formally or as a technical lead with hiring and mentorship responsibility. First-time managers with a demonstrated record of leading and developing people will be considered.
Strong understanding of drone technology, Public Safety sUAS operations, and regulatory compliance, including Drone as First Responder concepts of operation and dock based remote operations.
Working knowledge of Public Safety technologies, including CAD, VMS, and related software platforms, and the ability to lead integration discussions.
A track record of hiring, onboarding, and developing technical people, and of keeping them.
Comfort operating inside a Sales organization, including owning a quota, deal strategy, and the judgment to know when to commit technical resources and when to decline.
Excellent written and verbal communication. You can brief an operator, a program manager, and a senior executive without changing the facts.
Lead by example. Willing to do whatever is needed to get a customer situation resolved.

Nice to Have

Prior public safety service as a sworn officer, firefighter, or agency UAS program lead.
Experience standing up a Drone as First Responder program from waiver through go-live, and with dock-based, remote, and BVLOS operations at scale.
Familiarity with grant funding pathways and cooperative purchasing vehicles used by state and local agencies.
Working knowledge of Salesforce, Palantir, Databricks, or equivalents.
Track record of building and scaling a technical team through a period of rapid growth.

What Is Required

FAA Part 107 Certificate, or the ability to obtain one within 60 days of hire.
Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time.
Ability to lift up to 60 lbs unaided.

Compensation:
At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $172,000 - $215,000* + commission. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.

For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/

jobs.title: Director of IT Infrastructure & Operations
jobs.description:
As the Director of IT Infrastructure & Operations
at Brooks Safety Solutions, you will lead the core engine of our enterprise technology ecosystem across Brooks Safety Solutions and its affiliated brands. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will own the end-to-end architecture, reliability, and security of our multi-brand corporate networks, server environments, and IT service desk operations.

We are seeking a hands-on, proactive leader with a strong networking background. In the near term, this role is tactical: learning our current environment, closing gaps (particularly in the network), and keeping critical systems running. Over time, you will own the infrastructure roadmap and help move the technical team from reacting to problems to preventing them.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership & Organizational Scaling

Lead, mentor, and grow a six-member technical team, spanning Network Engineering, Systems/Cloud Engineering, Desktop Support, and IT Service Desk.
Define career progressions, set technical standards, and shift the team from reactive to proactive: finding and fixing issues before they affect the business.
Identify skill gaps and scale the team through strategic hiring, structured onboarding, and continuous training.

Infrastructure Architecture & Reliability

Set the strategic roadmap for on-premises, hybrid, and cloud infrastructure across all Brooks Safety Solutions brand locations, plants, and field offices.
Lead the migration from data center-based infrastructure to Microsoft Azure, including hybrid connectivity between on-premises networks and Azure.
Supervise core network engineering: SD-WAN, LAN/WLAN, routing/switching, firewalls, and secure site-to-site connectivity.
Direct server and platform administration across Azure, VMware/hypervisors, Windows/Linux server stacks, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and enterprise backup/DR pipelines.
Support the infrastructure behind the company’s move to Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).
Guarantee high availability, low downtime, and rapid RTO/RPO targets for mission-critical manufacturing and enterprise systems.

End-User Services & IT Help Desk Excellence

Own enterprise IT service management (ITSM), establishing clear SLAs, ticketing processes, hardware lifecycles, and automated provisioning workflows.
Drive first-touch resolution rates and ensure white-glove, customer-obsessed support for all brand business units and remote workers.

Vendor Management & Cost Optimization

Act as the lead negotiator and manager for all infrastructure-related vendor partnerships, MSPs, telecom/ISP carriers, software licensing, and hardware contracts.
Monitor performance against vendor Service Level Agreements (SLAs), drive competitive RFPs, and optimize CAPEX/OPEX infrastructure budgets.

Security, Compliance & Business Continuity

Partner closely with information security leadership to enforce endpoint protection, network segmentation, zero-trust principles, and vulnerability patching.
Build, test, and continuously maintain comprehensive Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Plans (BCP) across all operating entities.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience:
5+ years of hands-on enterprise networking experience, as part of a broader background in IT infrastructure and systems operations.
Leadership:
Proven ability to lead, develop, and hire for a small technical team (Network, Systems, Desktop/Help Desk).
Cloud & Azure:
Strong background in cloud infrastructure and hands-on Microsoft Azure experience, including Azure networking, hybrid on-premises-to-Azure connectivity, and moving workloads from on-premises data centers to the cloud.
Technical Breadth:
Strong background across enterprise networking (Cisco, Fortinet, Aruba, Palo Alto), server administration (Windows Server, Linux, virtualization), and modern workplace technologies (M365, Intune/MECM).
Communication & Approach:
Strong communicator who can explain technical issues to business leaders. Proactive: takes ownership of problems and addresses them before they escalate.
Vendor & Budget Acumen:
Demonstrated success negotiating multi-year enterprise contracts, managing vendor performance, and handling seven-figure infrastructure budgets.
Multi-Site/Multi-Brand Operations:
Experience standardizing infrastructure across acquisitions, subsidiaries, or geographically dispersed physical sites, including warehouses or distribution centers.
Frameworks & Methodology:
Deep familiarity with ITIL, NIST cybersecurity standards, and disaster recovery orchestration.

Preferred

Advanced Networking:
Depth beyond the required minimum, such as designing multi-site networks or leading a network redesign.
ERP:
Experience supporting the infrastructure for an ERP implementation; Microsoft Dynamics 365 a plus.
