jobs.title: Senior Director of Technology and Managed Services
jobs.description:
The Senior Director of Technology & Managed Services is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, operational performance, and continuous advancement of the organization’s technology ecosystem, managed service offerings, cybersecurity program, and enterprise business systems.

This leader oversees technology operations supporting internal business functions and customer-facing environments, including Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, GCC High, cybersecurity, analytics, automation, infrastructure, enterprise applications, end-user services, and managed services delivery.

The Senior Director maintains strong technical credibility and active involvement in architecture, cloud strategy, cybersecurity, risk management, and critical technology decisions. The role is primarily accountable for executive leadership, organizational development, governance, operational excellence, and long-term technology strategy rather than routine administration or day-to-day technical execution.

Working closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, customers, and technology teams, the Senior Director ensures technology investments align with organizational priorities, growth objectives, operational resilience, customer success, and regulatory requirements.

Primary Outcomes

Establish and execute a scalable enterprise technology strategy and multiyear roadmap.
Build a high-performing technology organization with clear accountability, empowered leaders, and effective succession planning.
Ensure secure, reliable, compliant, and cost-effective technology delivery across internal and customer-facing environments.
Mature managed services capabilities, service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational consistency.
Strengthen cybersecurity posture, risk management, compliance, business continuity, and resilience.
Reduce organizational dependence on any single technical leader by developing capable managers, team leads, and technical owners.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Business Partnership

Develop and execute an enterprise technology strategy aligned with organizational priorities, customer commitments, and long-term growth objectives.
Advise executive leadership on technology opportunities, risks, investments, operating models, and emerging trends.
Partner with business leaders to identify technology solutions that improve operational performance, efficiency, scalability, and customer outcomes.
Establish governance practices that support sound decision-making, resource prioritization, architecture alignment, and risk management.
Lead technology modernization and digital transformation across the organization.
Serve as a senior technology representative with customers, partners, vendors, and other external stakeholders.

Technology Operations and Service Delivery

Provide executive oversight for infrastructure, cloud platforms, networks, enterprise applications, collaboration technologies, end-user computing, service desk operations, and managed services.
Ensure technology services are delivered reliably, securely, efficiently, and in accordance with defined service expectations.
Establish service delivery standards, operational metrics, service-level objectives, escalation models, and continuous improvement practices.
Oversee major technology implementations, migrations, integrations, and modernization programs.
Lead executive response and decision-making during major outages, security events, and high-impact technology incidents.
Drive operational maturity through standardization, automation, documentation, knowledge management, and disciplined service management practices.

Managed Services and Customer Delivery

Provide strategic oversight for customer-hosted, cloud-based, managed, and compliance-focused technology environments.
Ensure managed services meet service commitments, customer expectations, security requirements, and contractual obligations.
Partner with account management, business development, delivery leaders, and customer stakeholders to support retention, growth, solution design, and successful service transitions.
Establish scalable operating models for supporting multiple customer environments with consistent governance, documentation, security, quality, and accountability.
Serve as an executive escalation point for critical customer technology issues and significant service disruptions.
Use customer feedback, service performance, operational data, and financial results to improve managed services delivery and customer experience.

Microsoft Cloud Strategy and Technology Governance

Provide leadership and governance for Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, GCC High, Azure Government dependencies, and related cloud architecture initiatives.
Ensure appropriate architecture standards, security controls, identity practices, tenant governance, and lifecycle-management frameworks are established for corporate and customer environments.
Review and approve major architecture decisions, platform standards, cloud investments, tenant strategies, and technology roadmaps.
Maintain sufficient technical depth to evaluate solution designs, challenge assumptions, mentor technical leaders, and guide critical decisions.
Provide coaching and technical guidance to managers, architects, engineers, administrators, developers, analysts, and security professionals.
Ensure day-to-day administration, troubleshooting, monitoring, and operational execution are assigned to capable managers, team leads, and technical owners.

Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, and Resilience

Lead development and execution of the organization’s cybersecurity and technology risk strategy.
Oversee security operations, identity and access governance, vulnerability management, incident response, business continuity, and disaster recovery programs.
Ensure effective governance of security capabilities across Microsoft cloud, hybrid, on-premises, and customer environments.
Oversee risk assessments, remediation programs, security investments, and compliance activities supporting regulatory, contractual, and customer requirements.
Monitor cybersecurity maturity and establish improvement plans addressing evolving threats, control gaps, and business risks.
Provide executive leadership with clear visibility into material technology and cybersecurity risks, decisions, and mitigation progress.

Financial and Vendor Leadership

Develop and manage technology operating and capital budgets, forecasts, investment plans, and financial priorities.
Prioritize investments based on business value, customer impact, risk reduction, total cost, service quality, and organizational capacity.
Oversee vendor selection, contract negotiations, service-provider performance, licensing strategies, and strategic technology partnerships.
Monitor technology spending, cloud consumption, licensing utilization, benefits realization, and cost-optimization opportunities.
Support financial planning, pricing, resource modeling, and cost-to-serve analysis for managed services and customer technology offerings.

Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a high-performing technology organization focused on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, customer service, and continuous improvement.
Develop leadership capacity through mentoring, coaching, succession planning, and deliberate delegation of authority and decision-making.
Establish clear ownership, decision rights, escalation paths, performance expectations, and development plans across technology teams.
Lead talent acquisition, workforce planning, organizational design, employee development, and retention initiatives.
Empower managers and team leads to own operational execution and technical decisions within their areas while maintaining appropriate executive visibility and governance.
Create an operating culture in which knowledge, administrative access, customer relationships, and critical responsibilities are distributed and documented rather than concentrated with one individual.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, engineering, business, or related discipline preferred. Relevant leadership experience and professional certifications may be considered in lieu of a degree.
Master’s degree in business administration, information systems, technology management, or related discipline preferred.

Professional Experience

At least 12 years of progressive technology experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
At least five years of experience leading technology managers, team leads, and cross-functional technology teams.
Demonstrated success developing and executing enterprise technology strategies and complex, large-scale initiatives.
Experience leading organizations responsible for cloud platforms, infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, business systems, end-user services, and technology operations.
Experience overseeing Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, tenant governance, and Microsoft cloud security programs.
Experience with GCC High, Azure Government dependencies, compliance-focused architectures, or regulated environments strongly preferred.
Experience leading customer-facing managed technology services, including service-level management, customer escalations, contractual obligations, and multi-customer operations.
Demonstrated success managing significant technology budgets, strategic vendors, licensing programs, and complex technology contracts.
Proven ability to build leadership teams, develop technical owners, delegate effectively, and scale technology organizations.

Technical Knowledge

Candidates should possess strong working knowledge of the following areas:

Microsoft Azure and cloud architecture
Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID
Microsoft 365 GCC High and Azure Government dependencies
Identity and access management
Cybersecurity operations, governance, and compliance
Infrastructure, networking, endpoint management, and service delivery
Business continuity and disaster recovery
Enterprise applications, integrations, analytics, automation, and digital transformation platforms

Role expectation:
The successful candidate is not expected to personally administer these technologies on a routine basis but must possess sufficient expertise to lead, govern, mentor, challenge, and guide the teams responsible for them.

Preferred Certifications

Relevant credentials may include Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Administrator Associate, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, CISSP, CISM, ITIL, or PMP.

Key Competencies

Strategic leadership and execution
Managed services and customer leadership
Executive communication and influence
Cybersecurity and risk governance
Technology and architecture governance
Financial acumen
Microsoft cloud strategy and oversight
Vendor and contract negotiation
Business partnership
Change and transformation leadership
Organizational design and leadership development
Delegation, accountability, and succession planning

Success Measures

Strategic and Business Outcomes

Progress against the approved technology strategy and roadmap.
Alignment of technology investments with business priorities, customer commitments, and growth objectives.
Successful delivery and adoption of modernization and transformation initiatives.

Organizational Outcomes

Leadership bench strength, succession readiness, and clearly assigned ownership.
Employee engagement, retention, development, and managerial effectiveness.
Reduction of operational and decision-making dependence on the Senior Director or any other single individual.

Operational and Customer Outcomes

Service availability, reliability, performance, resilience, and service-level attainment.
Managed services quality, customer satisfaction, contractual performance, and retention support.

jobs.title: Sr. Director- Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Lilly's Purpose

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our 35,000 employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Come develop great software solutions to solve exciting problems to help patients!

The Software Product Engineering organization is actively looking for a Software Engineering Manager. Are you determined to deliver the best user-centered solutions? Are you ready to own the technical strategy for one or more domains and shape the next generation of application development at Lilly? If so, please apply.

What You'll Be Doing

As the leader of an engineering team accountable for one or more domains, or bounded contexts, within our Commercial or Clinical portfolio, you will set the multi-year technical direction for those domains and use the best of what modern web technologies and architecture have to offer, to design solutions that transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes. These products will meet patients where they are due to your close collaboration with our user-experience, product, business, medical, and regulatory partners. You will define the engineering standards, platform investments, and ways of working that extend beyond your own team, and you will partner with business and technology leaders to translate portfolio strategy into a funded, staffed engineering roadmap that is responsive to both business and patient needs. You will also ready your domains for an agentic future: raising the team's fluency with AI-assisted engineering, designing systems and data so that well-governed APIs, tools, and context are available for agents to act on safely, and making deliberate, evidence-based choices about where AI and agentic capabilities create real value for the business and for patients rather than novelty.

How You'll Succeed:

As a Software Engineering Manager, you will bring both your leadership and technical depth to set direction for the applications and platform capabilities across your domains that exceed product goals and transform the ecosystem.
Leveraging your strong background in software engineering to guide the team's work, resolve the most ambiguous and technically complex problems, and own technology and architecture direction for the products and platforms in your domains, including build-versus-buy, platform consolidation, and technical-debt investment decisions that play out over multiple planning cycles.
Owning a multi-year technical roadmap for your domains: sequencing platform investment against business outcomes, quantifying the trade-offs, and defending that plan in annual planning and funding cycles.
By maximizing the potential of your team, providing guidance, mentorship and growth opportunities, deepening the technical capability of the team, and deliberately developing the next generation of technical leads and people managers, while fostering a collaborative work environment that promotes innovation.
Matching unique product needs to the resources and skills within your team, while owning headcount planning, budget, and vendor and partner sourcing for your domains, and forecasting capacity several quarters ahead against a demand pipeline you help shape.
Driving process change beyond your own team, continuously evaluating and enhancing software engineering processes, methodologies, and tools to improve efficiency, quality, and productivity, and establishing the engineering standards and metrics that peer teams adopt.
Owning the operational health of your domains — service levels, reliability, incident response, security posture, and adherence to data privacy and regulatory requirements — and making the investment case when that health needs attention.
As a superb communicator and influencer with strong interpersonal skills, you will work and collaborate effectively with your team and product stakeholders, and build alignment across engineering, product, design, and business leadership, representing engineering at the Director and Executive Director level.
Setting clear objectives, scope and schedules, ensuring the team understands of expectations and priorities, and making transparent, well-reasoned trade-offs when strategy, capacity, and timelines conflict.
Owning the hiring bar and talent strategy for your domains: attracting strong technical talent, building succession depth for critical roles, and managing performance with candor.

Your Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical engineering discipline, including Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Information Science, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Information Systems (CIS), Management Information Systems (MIS), Cloud Computing, Data Science
8+ years working in software engineering roles
5+years of experience as a software engineering manager
Experience of ownership of the technical strategy and delivery roadmap for one or more domains, sustained across multiple planning cycles
Experience with web and cloud technologies

What You Should Bring:

Master's degree preferred
Experience leading multiple concurrent, complex engineering programs from inception to production, including modernizing or retiring legacy systems along the way.
Deep professional work experience in software engineering, building customer facing applications using Node.js, Vue.js, Python, Java, Scala, Go or Rust.
Depth across full-stack and platform engineering — RESTful APIs, microservice and event-driven architectures, distributed data management, observability, DevOps and CI/CD, and public cloud (AWS or Azure) — with the judgment to choose among these for a given problem and own the consequences of that choice over the life of the system.
A strong ability to architect and design robust, high-scale systems and to challenge engineers to think bigger and more generically in developing their solutions, and to make and document durable architectural decisions that other teams build on.
Demonstrated ability to scope, schedule and resource multiple complex programs in collaboration with cross functional partners and external delivery partners.
Demonstrated ability to translate business or portfolio strategy into an engineering roadmap, and to communicate that roadmap credibly to senior leadership.
Self-motivated, independent, and proactive, with outstanding communication skills. Can effectively communicate complex ideas and make compelling arguments, and influence outcomes without formal authority.
Excellent cross-functional influencer with experience working in a fast-paced environment with frequent context switching, including sustained engagement with senior stakeholders.
A working understanding of core concepts related to Machine Learning/AI and Data Engineering, and a clear point of view on where they create leverage in your domains.
Distributed data storage and processing framework experience (Spark and Hadoop).
Experience growing and maturing software engineering teams and technical leaders, including coaching tech leads and emerging managers, to efficiently deliver high quality software products.
Experience operating in a regulated environment (healthcare, life sciences, or financial services), with working knowledge of data privacy, security, and quality or compliance expectations for sensitive personal data.

Your Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical engineering discipline, including Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Information Science, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Information Systems (CIS), Management Information Systems (MIS), Cloud Computing, Data Science
8+ years working in software engineering roles
5+years of experience as a software engineering manager
Experience of ownership of the technical strategy and delivery roadmap for one or more domains, sustained across multiple planning cycles
Experience with web and cloud technologies

About The Organization

Lilly IT builds and maintains capabilities using groundbreaking technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business.

Lilly's Software Product Engineering (SPE) organization is focused on building core foundational software platforms to accelerate our ability to reach and support patients digitally. This organization is powered by software engineering experts that solve challenging problems around patient engagement and drug discovery with code.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).

$159,000 - $233,200

Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits;

jobs.title: Director of AI Product Management, Platform
jobs.description:
This role requires a hybrid schedule and will be based in our South Charlotte, NC or New York, NY office.

Red Ventures Growth and Transformation empowers partners through a unique blend of high-scale proprietary distribution, data models, AI-enabled applications, and strategic client partnerships. We help our clients unlock significant and sustainable growth across the home services and financial services ecosystems, ranging from telecommunications and deregulated energy to credit cards and deposits. As a Red Ventures company, we have more than 20 years of experience building strategic, long-standing relationships with some of the world's most powerful brands across industries like financial services, retail, real estate, and entertainment.

We believe the next phase of advantage will come from integrated operating systems that connect decisioning, execution, intelligence, and governance into a shared foundation that improves over time. RVGT is investing in that future through our Growth Operating System, a set of reusable workflows, agents, context layers, and governance mechanisms designed to help our teams and our partners drive growth more efficiently, more intelligently, and at greater scale.

At the center of that system is our enterprise AI agent platform, the layer our teams and partners use to build, govern, deploy, and operate AI agents, including inside some of the largest institutions in the country. The platform is not a single application. It is the foundation that lets every application be built faster and run more safely, anchored in three commitments: governance by default (security, privacy, and compliance built into every agent and every tool connection), codified learning that compounds time to value across teams, and lab-agnostic AI management so our partners are never locked into a single model provider or agent framework.

We are seeking a Director of AI Product Management, Platform, to own the platform's product strategy and roadmap. You will lead a team defining the core capabilities that every agent depends on: agent authoring and promotion workflows, tool and data connectivity through MCP, identity and access, policy and governance controls, observability and cost management, and deployment models that meet the requirements of regulated enterprise clients. Your customers are the product and engineering teams building on the platform, the client stakeholders who must approve it, and the business leaders who need to see measurable impact from it.This role carries significant visibility across our client services division and with our partners. You will help stakeholders understand what the platform is and why it matters and drive adoption that turns platform investment into business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Identify & drive initiatives: Generate the product roadmap for the client partnership and lead multiple AI product initiatives, ensuring alignment with product leadership, partner objectives, customer needs, and broader RVGT strategy. Develop business cases and assess feasibility, impact, and ROI in partnership with business and client stakeholders.
Translate vision into action: Turn high-level strategy into actionable workstreams, defining sequencing, resourcing, and execution plans in partnership with product team members and cross-functional leads. Create clarity and alignment.
Own outcomes: Own the business impact of your initiatives, communicating progress, ROI, risks, and opportunities to leadership and client partners, shaping the go-forward for each workstream to ensure it’s positioned to deliver meaningful impact, getting hands-on where necessary to unblock our hardest tasks and hurdles.
Advance the Operating System: Collect qualitative and technical feedback from agentic workflows running through the platform and use that to lift all boats and advance the fundamental feature set of enabling technology.

jobs.title: Senior Director, System Engineering & Intelligence, Global
jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI. We own and operate the full stack — energy, data centres, GPU superclusters, orchestration, and AI services — delivering high-performance infrastructure to AI-native companies, enterprises, and governments across Europe and the US. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world.

At Nscale, our Data Centre Systems Engineering team designs the systems, data, and intelligence that let us build and operate AI data centres at a speed and density traditional operating models were never designed for. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About The Role

Nscale's operational systems (BMS, DCIM, EPMS/SCADA, CMMS/EAM, ITSM, fabric and GPU telemetry) and equipment data were procured independently. Each works well on its own, but together they give overlapping and sometimes contradictory views of the same assets.

As Senior Director, System Engineering & Intelligence, you will bring that data centre insight together. You'll own the equipment digital thread — from product definition and procurement through commissioning and handover into maintenance — along with the telemetry and analytics foundation that lets the Nscale Operational Systems (NOS) act on our physical estate with confidence.

The goal is data centres that are measurably self-aware and progressively self-operating, where a site is declared ready based on evidence rather than judgement.

What You'll be Doing

Set strategy and investment: own a costed, sequenced multi-year roadmap and investment portfolio across CMMS/EAM, PIM/PLM, integration, telemetry, and the data platform, starting with an assessment of which systems should be consolidated, retained, replaced, or newly instrumented.
Own the asset master and governance: establish one canonical identity for every asset, along with taxonomy, hierarchy, configuration, and BOM standards, ensuring every critical data object has one system of record.
Lead cleansing and validation-at-source programmes so governed lifecycle data replaces spreadsheets.
Build the telemetry foundation: deliver a unified asset and topology model from grid connection down to GPU and network port, with OT/IT ingest (Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA, MQTT, Redfish, DCGM) and IEC 62443-aligned segmentation.
Publish data-quality scores and agree single, shared definitions for PUE, WUE, capacity, stranded power, and availability.
Make maintenance and reliability trustworthy: own the CMMS/EAM configuration baseline (criticality, PM strategy, spares, warranties) and controlled SOP/MOP/EOP libraries.
Map condition data deterministically to assets so predictive maintenance raises work orders, not just reports.
Move NOS intelligence toward autonomy: build anomaly detection, remaining-useful-life prediction, and thermal and power optimisation.
Progress control loops through shadow, recommend-only, human-approved, and bounded-autonomous stages, each with explicit safety envelopes and engineering sign-off.
Assure site readiness: turn commissioning (L1–L5) into data, set acceptance gates for handover, and score readiness quantitatively per hall and per site.
Benchmark readiness across the portfolio so defects found on one build are designed out of the next.
Act as the senior escalation point across Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Operations, Reliability, Platform, Finance, and HSE, and enforce supplier and OFCI data deliverables.
Build and develop a high-performing team spanning lifecycle engineering, data science, and data engineering.

About You

15+ years of experience across engineering, asset management, enterprise systems, or industrial analytics, including 7+ years leading cross-functional programmes at director level or above.
Ownership of a CMMS/EAM platform at scale (e.g. Maximo, SAP PM, Infor, Nuvolo), plus depth in master data, PIM/PLM, BOM, and configuration management.
Proven delivery of analytics or ML on physical infrastructure (data centres, energy, utilities, heavy industry, or similar), including hands-on experience with messy BMS/SCADA/historian data.
Experience taking models into control or decision loops, along with the safety, validation, and governance work that requires.
Strong judgement on enterprise and data architecture, including ERP, integration, streaming, time-series storage, lineage, and Palantir Foundry or an equivalent platform.
Experience with ITIL-aligned operations and controlled MOP, LOTO, and permit-to-work regimes in mission-critical environments.
Credibility with both facilities engineers and software teams.
A track record of building a function from scratch.
Honesty and clarity with executives about uncertainty.

Nice to Have

Knowledge of AI/HPC data centre plant, including liquid cooling, UPS, switchgear, and GPU and fabric telemetry.
Familiarity with reliability standards such as RCM, FMEA, ISO 14224, and ISO 55000.
Experience with digital twin or CFD-informed modelling.
Experience with BIM/COBie handover.
Background in energy and grid optimisation.

Why this role matters

This role turns a fragmented set of systems into a single, trusted source of truth for how Nscale's data centres are built, run, and improved. Success will be measured by:

Fewer unplanned incidents, faster detection and diagnosis, and more interventions triggered by prediction rather than alarms.
Improved PM compliance, MTTR, and spares fill rate.
PUE/WUE gains and stranded capacity recovered.
Cohesive analytics views across the data centre landscape.
Fewer post-energisation defects and a shorter time from mechanical completion to customer-ready.
Less redundant tooling and more critical assets with governed, quality-scored data.
Control loops advanced toward autonomy with zero safety-envelope breaches.

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

Highly competitive package, including base salary and equity, with reviews every 12 months.
Join one of the fastest-growing tech startups: your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI.
Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
Human-first flexibility. We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.
Join our thriving remote-first team. Geography is no barrier to impact or connection. We build seamless virtual collaboration, empowering you wherever you work.

Equal Opportunities Statement

At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enrich our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

Together, our talented team is working to make a meaningful difference for patients and their families.

What We Do Matters.

The Opportunity

The Vice President, Information Technology (IT) is the senior technology leader for REGENXBIO, responsible for setting and executing an enterprise IT strategy that enables corporate priorities and prepares the organization for continued growth and commercialization. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, this strategic and hands-on leader serves as a trusted advisor to executive and functional leaders and oversees the full IT portfolio, including enterprise applications, infrastructure and cloud services, cybersecurity, data and analytics, digital enablement, end-user services, and technology vendor partnerships. The VP, IT will also guide the responsible adoption of automation, artificial intelligence, and other emerging technologies to simplify work, strengthen decision-making, and create measurable business value.

How You’ll Contribute

Technology Strategy & Commercialization Readiness
Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise IT strategy and roadmap aligned with REGENXBIO's clinical development priorities, commercialization plans, operating model, and growth
Advise executive and functional leaders on technology investments, risks, tradeoffs, and sequencing required to move from a clinical-stage company to a commercial organization

Lead enterprise technology readiness for commercialization, including scalable capabilities for manufacturing and supply chain, Quality, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, commercial operations, patient services, Finance, and Human Resources as business needs evolve

Establish and lead enterprise IT portfolio and project management governance, including investment prioritization, resource planning, delivery methodologies, project controls, risk and dependency management, executive reporting, and benefits realization

Select, implement, integrate, and optimize fit-for-purpose solutions; simplify the application portfolio and design integrations and data flows that can scale for commercial operations
Lead the Business Analysis capability, establishing standards and practices for business process analysis, requirements management, solution evaluation, process design, and translation of business needs into scalable technology solutions
Establish service levels, operational metrics, and continuous improvement practices that strengthen system performance, responsiveness, and user experience

Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance
Set and maintain the enterprise cybersecurity strategy and information security management approach, including policies, controls, monitoring, awareness, and risk management
Establish and direct the IT strategy and governance framework including GxP-regulated systems, ensuring technology capabilities, processes, and controls meet applicable regulatory, quality, data integrity, privacy, public company, and information security requirements throughout the system lifecycle
Ensure effective lifecycle governance for regulated systems, including risk assessment, validation planning and execution, change control, periodic review, data integrity, supplier oversight, and system retirement
Lead and maintain REGENXBIO’s information security management system and ISO 27001 responsibilities
Lead technology business continuity, disaster recovery, incident preparedness, and technology risk management
Partner with Legal, Quality, Compliance, Finance, and business leaders to maintain appropriate governance for data, systems, access, and technology-enabled processes

Data, Digital Enablement & Innovation
Build governed data, integration, analytics, and reporting capabilities that provide trusted information for clinical, operational, and commercial decisions
Identify and implement practical uses of automation, artificial intelligence, and other emerging technologies that improve productivity and business outcomes
Establish responsible governance for AI-enabled solutions and lead adoption so new tools and processes deliver sustained value

Vendor, Financial & Portfolio Management
Own IT budgeting, forecasting, investment planning, and resource allocation, with a focus on business value, scalability, risk, and cost effectiveness
Lead vendor selection, contracting support, performance management, and strategic relationships with technology providers, consultants, and managed service partners
Maintain internal ownership of technology architecture, standards, security, data, and outcomes while using external partners where they provide the greatest value

Leadership & Organization
Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing IT organization with clear accountabilities, strong technical and business capabilities, and a customer-focused service mindset
Set clear priorities and outcomes, assign ownership, and hold the team and partners accountable for delivery
Foster a collaborative culture that supports innovation, learning, direct communication, and continuous improvement while balancing speed, quality, risk, and compliance
Communicate complex technology topics in clear business terms and build strong partnerships across functions and levels

REGENXBIO employees must embody the company's core values by collaborating, building strong relationships, and communicating clearly to meet shared objectives

What You’ll Bring

15+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including enterprise-wide accountability in a high-growth or highly regulated organization
Experience leading IT in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or healthcare; experience preparing a clinical-stage company for commercialization or scaling a commercial biotechnology organization strongly preferred
Broad technology leadership experience spanning enterprise applications, cloud and infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and analytics, integration, end-user services, and IT operations

Strong understanding of regulated technology environments, including FDA regulated environments, system validation, data integrity, cybersecurity, privacy, business continuity, and disaster recovery. Experience with ISO 27001 and public-company or Sarbanes-Oxley requirements is required
Experience establishing commercialization-ready technology and data capabilities across functions such as Manufacturing and Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, Patient Services, and Finance

jobs.title: Director of AI Product Management, Platform
jobs.description:
This role requires a hybrid schedule and will be based in our South Charlotte, NC or New York, NY office.

Red Ventures Growth and Transformation empowers partners through a unique blend of high-scale proprietary distribution, data models, AI-enabled applications, and strategic client partnerships. We help our clients unlock significant and sustainable growth across the home services and financial services ecosystems, ranging from telecommunications and deregulated energy to credit cards and deposits. As a Red Ventures company, we have more than 20 years of experience building strategic, long-standing relationships with some of the world's most powerful brands across industries like financial services, retail, real estate, and entertainment.

We believe the next phase of advantage will come from integrated operating systems that connect decisioning, execution, intelligence, and governance into a shared foundation that improves over time. RVGT is investing in that future through our Growth Operating System, a set of reusable workflows, agents, context layers, and governance mechanisms designed to help our teams and our partners drive growth more efficiently, more intelligently, and at greater scale.

At the center of that system is our enterprise AI agent platform, the layer our teams and partners use to build, govern, deploy, and operate AI agents, including inside some of the largest institutions in the country. The platform is not a single application. It is the foundation that lets every application be built faster and run more safely, anchored in three commitments: governance by default (security, privacy, and compliance built into every agent and every tool connection), codified learning that compounds time to value across teams, and lab-agnostic AI management so our partners are never locked into a single model provider or agent framework.

We are seeking a Director of AI Product Management, Platform, to own the platform's product strategy and roadmap. You will lead a team defining the core capabilities that every agent depends on: agent authoring and promotion workflows, tool and data connectivity through MCP, identity and access, policy and governance controls, observability and cost management, and deployment models that meet the requirements of regulated enterprise clients. Your customers are the product and engineering teams building on the platform, the client stakeholders who must approve it, and the business leaders who need to see measurable impact from it.This role carries significant visibility across our client services division and with our partners. You will help stakeholders understand what the platform is and why it matters and drive adoption that turns platform investment into business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Identify & drive initiatives: Generate the product roadmap for the client partnership and lead multiple AI product initiatives, ensuring alignment with product leadership, partner objectives, customer needs, and broader RVGT strategy. Develop business cases and assess feasibility, impact, and ROI in partnership with business and client stakeholders.
Translate vision into action: Turn high-level strategy into actionable workstreams, defining sequencing, resourcing, and execution plans in partnership with product team members and cross-functional leads. Create clarity and alignment.
Own outcomes: Own the business impact of your initiatives, communicating progress, ROI, risks, and opportunities to leadership and client partners, shaping the go-forward for each workstream to ensure it’s positioned to deliver meaningful impact, getting hands-on where necessary to unblock our hardest tasks and hurdles.
Advance the Operating System: Collect qualitative and technical feedback from agentic workflows running through the platform and use that to lift all boats and advance the fundamental feature set of enabling technology.
Develop talent: Manage and develop a team of product managers at various levels, creating specific plans, providing hands-on product and analytical support, delegating appropriate work, and instilling a performance-driven environment through clear expectations, regular feedback, and recognition of achievements.

What We’re Looking For

Commercially grounded: You bring an entrepreneurial mindset paired with strong commercial instincts, identifying where platform investments unlock measurable efficiency across teams, and connecting delivery wins to the platform’s long-term compounding value.
Relationship-driven: You build durable relationships with internal leaders, understanding their motivations and constraints, and using these partnerships to shape decisions, secure alignment, and accelerate impact.
Technical fluency: You are deeply technical and architecturally fluent, understanding how modern agent systems actually work (models, harnesses, tool protocols, memory, evaluation, and runtime infrastructure) well enough to make sound tradeoffs alongside engineering and recognize which layers the platform should own versus abstract. You translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and leverage modern AI tools to accelerate product development.
Customer centric: High-level empathy for the teams who build on and depend on the platform, with a sharp sense for developer experience and governance design - able to thread the needle between customer enablement and necessary friction for governance.
Deeply curious: You have a genuine drive to understand how the world is changing and how emerging AI capabilities can be applied in practice. You invest time in staying close to new developments, forming clear opinions on what makes systems effective, and bringing that perspective into product strategy, team leadership, and execution.
Systems and governance minded: You design governance-by-default infrastructure, so partners can build and deploy safely without re-solving the same problem each time.You bring strong platform product judgment, knowing which abstractions will hold, when to standardize versus stay flexible, and you're willing to say no to one-off requests in service of a platform that scales.

Experiences You've Had

End-to-end ownership: Experience driving AI/ML products from concept through iteration, guiding a team through delivery, and owning the outcomes and business impact of the work.
Driving complex decision-making: Experience influencing cross-functional leaders, navigating competing priorities across internal teams and regulated client requirements, and making high-impact platform decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Built from experience: You’ve worked hands-on with production-grade AI systems, whether evaluating model behavior, running analyses (sql, python), building agent infrastructure, and codifying that work into reusable capabilities that compound time-to-value across teams. You're comfortable operating close to the details, whether that's diagnosing a runtime issue, reading an architecture review, or sitting with a client's security team to work through a compliance question.
Partner engagement: Experience serving as a strategic partner to both internal delivery teams and external client stakeholders who must approve what's deployed into their environment, leading discovery, validating opportunities, and aligning teams around shared goals, particularly in regulated or enterprise contexts.
People leader: Managed teams of product managers, including being a manager of managers - providing feedback and encouragement with direct responsibility for the team’s contributions.

Compensation

Total Cash Compensation Range: $215,0000 – $305,000 per year

New York City Total Cash Compensation Range: $268,750 – $381,250 per year

This role is also eligible for Equity, which is offered separately from the total cash compensation listed above. Actual compensation varies based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Additionally, the following benefits are provided by Red Ventures, subject to eligibility requirements.

Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision)
Life Insurance
Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
Holiday Pay
401(k) with match
Employee Assistance Program
Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program
Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO): We believe time to rest and recharge is essential. That’s why we offer a generous and flexible PTO policy. Full-time employees accrue 20 days of PTO for a full calendar year annually, with an increase to 25 days after five years of service.

Who We Are

Red Ventures is a global portfolio of high-growth companies — spanning several U.S. businesses, a joint venture in the health services industry, and strategic investments in Europe. Their businesses include The Points Guy, Lonely Planet, Bankrate, the Allconnect Platform, RV Home Client Growth, RV Growth & Transformation, Sage Home Loans Corporation, and more. Across the portfolio, Red Ventures businesses deliver seamless digital experiences for consumers, help Fortune 100 clients solve large-scale digital growth challenges, and create world-class experiences and opportunities for employees. Learn more at redventures.com and follow @RedVentures on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At Red Ventures, we believe diverse, inclusive teams are better. To help you better understand our core values and beliefs, we encourage you to watch this brief YouTube video: Our Belief Statements. This will give you insight into the principles that guide our work and our commitment to fostering an inclusive environment.

We offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits program for full-time employees, including medical, dental and vision coverage, paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, 401(k) plan and a paid parental leave program.

Red Ventures is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or any other basis protected by law. Employment at Red Ventures is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications.

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. This includes providing reasonable accommodation where appropriate. Should you require a reasonable accommodation to apply or participate in the job application or interview process, please contact accommodation@redventures.com.

At Red Ventures, we believe in real human connection. That’s why we do not hire someone through text, social media, or email only. At Symmons we are dedicated to delivering excellence in every aspect of our business. Our success is driven by our commitment to our core values: being customer-focused, embracing a can-do attitude, demonstrating resilience, and always striving to win as a team. We believe in fostering a positive and collaborative work environment where every team member can thrive and contribute to our shared goals.

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Director Information Technology
to join our team. In this role, you will be required to be in onsite in office each day and will play a crucial part in helping us achieve our mission by putting our core values into action every day. If you are passionate about providing exceptional service, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are ready to make a significant impact, we want to hear from you!

The Director of Information Technology
leads the company’s IT strategy, operations, infrastructure, cybersecurity, business applications, and IT support functions. This role ensures technology supports business objectives while maintaining a secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective environment.

The Director serves as a strategic partner to executive and business leaders. The position also leads the IT team and technology partners, manages IT budgets and projects, and ensures appropriate policies, controls, and business continuity plans are in place.

Responsibilities

IT Strategy & Business Partnership

Partner with leadership to identify technology solutions that improve efficiency, productivity, and business performance.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions based on business value, cost, risk, and implementation requirements.

Cybersecurity & Information Risk Management

Develop and maintain the company’s cybersecurity strategy and information security practices.
Monitor threats, vulnerabilities, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
Oversee security policies, access controls, monitoring, endpoint and data protection, and employee cybersecurity awareness.
Lead cybersecurity incident response and coordinate internal and external resources.
Manage technology and cybersecurity risks associated with third-party providers.

Infrastructure, Systems & Business Applications

Oversee IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, hardware, cloud environments, telecommunications, and end-user technology.
Oversee ERP, CRM, business applications, integrations, and other critical technology platforms.
Maintain appropriate documentation of the technology environment, systems, policies, and procedures.

IT Projects & Technology Implementation

Establish and manage an IT project portfolio aligned with company priorities.
Oversee technology projects from planning and budgeting through implementation, testing, training, and support.
Ensure projects are properly scoped, resourced, prioritized, and delivered in alignment with business objectives.

Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery

Develop and maintain IT business continuity and disaster recovery plans.
Ensure appropriate backup, recovery, redundancy, and recovery capabilities for critical systems and data.
Lead technology response and recovery efforts following significant outages, cybersecurity incidents, or business disruptions.

IT Team Leadership

Lead, develop, and mentor the IT team, establishing clear objectives, accountability, and performance expectations.
Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer service.

Vendor & Managed Service Provider Management

Provide strategic oversight of managed service providers and technology vendors.
Manage vendor relationships, service levels, contracts, performance, cybersecurity practices, and costs.
Identify opportunities to improve service and maximize technology investments.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive IT experience, including at least 5 years in an IT leadership or management role.
Proven experience developing and executing IT strategy in a business environment.
Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, ERP systems, networks, and cloud technologies.
Experience managing IT projects, budgets, vendors, and managed service providers.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in a manufacturing or similarly operationally complex environment.
Experience with ERP and CRM platforms.
Experience with AWS, Salesforce, or similar cloud-based platforms.

Company Overview

In 1939, Paul Symmons advanced the plumbing industry by inventing the first anti-scald, pressure-balancing valve. 87 years later his legacy lives on through the Temptrol® valve, which is still made right here in the USA.

While the vision of Paul Symmons is never out of sight, we’re constantly pressing forward, challenging ourselves and the industry to be better… to do better. As we design and redesign the minute details, we’re also conscious of the bigger things, like water conservation, and energy reduction, and global impact.

That’s what we do here at Symmons – we make things right.

Headquartered in Braintree, Massachusetts, Symmons is now part of the Harbour Group’s portfolio of companies. Harbour Group is a privately owned operations-focused company based in St. Louis, Missouri, focused on the long-term growth for manufacturing companies. For more information about Symmons and its product catalog, visit www.symmons.com

Symmons offers a competitive compensation package including excellent benefits and a 401k plan with 100% match up to the first 6% of eligible wages with immediate vesting. The pay range reflects our good faith estimate at the time of posting and does not guarantee a specific wage. Actual pay will depend on skills, experience, and other job-related factors.

If you are ready to bring your passion, skills, and can-do attitude to Symmons, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Please submit your application/resume at: https://careers-symmons.icims.com

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

About the Role

The CTO will own technology for doit Holdings, our regulated investment platform in Malaysia. This is a build role. The platform does not exist yet, and it has to be built inside a technology risk framework that satisfies the Securities Commission's Guidelines on Technology Risk Management from the first line of code. The role runs from architecture and engineering execution through to the systems evidence the SC assesses at registration.

What you will be doing

Own architecture and major technical decisions for the platform, from onboarding and order routing through records, reporting and the partner interfaces.
Build and lead the engineering team, and set standards across reliability, security, performance, testing and code quality.
Implement the SC's technology risk requirements as engineering practice: change control and approvals, secure development, testing and acceptance, capacity and resilience.
Produce the systems evidence behind the readiness declaration a director and the Responsible Person must sign before the platform may operate.
Take the platform through the independent technology validation that gates registration, and close what it finds.
Own business continuity and disaster recovery, tested rather than documented.
Own cloud, vendor and outsourcing arrangements, where the board remains accountable for everything outsourced.

What you will need

Deep software engineering background with experience building and scaling production systems.
Strong knowledge of backend systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
Experience making architecture decisions across multiple products or engineering teams.
Strong technical judgement and ability to challenge engineering decisions at implementation level.
Capable of building world-class engineering teams.
Still technically hands-on - able to review code, architecture, incidents and difficult engineering problems directly.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Technical interview
3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Chief Technology Officer | Agentic AI

Executive Leadership | Enterprise AI | Agentic Systems | 0→1 Platform Build

We are partnering exclusively with an early-stage AI company to appoint a Chief Technology Officer
for one of the most ambitious enterprise agentic platforms we have encountered.

The company has spent several years developing its underlying technology and is now entering a pivotal stage of expansion.

The thesis is straightforward but enormous:
As enterprises move from copilots to hundreds or thousands of autonomous agents performing real work, they will require an independent infrastructure layer to orchestrate those agents, connect them securely to proprietary intelligence and tools, govern their behavior, and operate across an increasingly fragmented ecosystem of models and compute.

This company intends to build that layer.

We are looking for an exceptional technical builder, architect and engineering leader
to work directly alongside the CEO and help define what that platform becomes.

This is not a traditional management-oriented CTO appointment
.

The successful individual will remain deeply engaged with architecture and engineering while building an exceptional technical organization around them. You should be equally comfortable debating the architecture of an agent runtime, whiteboarding a distributed system, reviewing critical technical decisions and recruiting world-class engineers.

What You'll Own
Technical vision, architecture and engineering strategy for an enterprise-grade agentic AI platform
Architecture spanning agent runtimes/harnesses, orchestration, state/context, memory, tools/actions, multi-agent systems and human-in-the-loop workflows

Model abstraction and routing across frontier, open-source, specialized and private models
Enterprise intelligence/context infrastructure and secure access to proprietary data
Agent evaluation, observability, guardrails, permissions, reliability and failure recovery
Cloud-native and distributed infrastructure capable of supporting sophisticated production agent workloads
Technical roadmap alongside the CEO, Product and commercial leadership
Recruitment and development of a world-class engineering organization
The transition from an already substantial technical foundation into a category-defining enterprise platform

What We're Looking For

You are likely a CTO, technical founder, VP Engineering, Head of AI/Engineering or exceptional senior technical leader
who has already built sophisticated AI/platform technology.

Most importantly, you have actually built agentic systems
.

We're interested in people who can go significantly deeper than saying their organization uses LangChain, LangGraph, MCP or an LLM API. You understand the underlying abstractions: how agents reason and execute, how state persists, how tools are exposed, how context is managed, how multiple agents coordinate, how failures are contained, how systems are evaluated and how the entire architecture operates reliably in production.

You will ideally bring:
Exceptional software engineering and computer systems fundamentals
Deep production experience with agentic AI / LLM systems

Agent orchestration, runtimes or harness architecture
Distributed systems and platform/infrastructure engineering
Python, Go, Rust and/or TypeScript depth
Cloud-native architecture, Kubernetes and modern infrastructure
Production experience around tools, state, memory, context, evals and observability
Experience taking complex technology from 0→1 and subsequently scaling it

Evidence of building and attracting exceptional engineering teams
Strong product instincts and an ability to translate an ambitious technical thesis into something enterprises can actually deploy
Comfort operating with significant ambiguity, autonomy and ownership

Experience with coding agents, autonomous software development, enterprise AI infrastructure, model routing, AI gateways/control planes, MCP/A2A, RAG/context infrastructure, inference infrastructure or AI developer platforms
would be particularly interesting.

Why This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to join before the category has been fully defined
, not after.

You won't inherit a mature roadmap and simply manage its execution. You'll have the opportunity to help determine the architecture, technical philosophy, product boundaries and engineering organization of a company pursuing a much larger question:
If AI agents become a new enterprise workforce, what infrastructure will enterprises need to own, control and govern that intelligence?

The CEO is an exceptionally ambitious founder looking for a genuine technical counterpart
, not simply an engineering manager.

There is substantial ownership, direct influence over company strategy and the opportunity to build at the intersection of agents, enterprise intelligence, models, governance and AI infrastructure
.

We are moving quickly and will be deliberately selective.

If you have built sophisticated agentic systems and believe the next generation of enterprise software will be fundamentally agent-driven, I'd like to hear from you.

Apply directly or reach out confidentially with your resume and availability for an initial discussion.

new_jobs.title: Director of Security Engineering
new_jobs.description:
About The Role

Abnormal AI protects organizations from the most sophisticated email and collaboration attacks using behavioral AI. Security is not a bolt-on at Abnormal; it is core to the product we sell and the trust our customers place in us. Our security organization operates a commercial cloud environment and a separate FedRAMP-authorized environment, and we are pursuing increasingly rigorous federal authorizations as we grow.

We are hiring a Director of Security reporting to the CISO and leading the Security Engineering organization. You will build and scale high-performing security teams, own major security programs end to end, and operate autonomously in the CISO's absence, including representing security to executive leadership, customers, and auditors.

This is a role for a deeply technical leader with a software engineering background who has grown into people leadership. You have built security teams from the ground up, you write and review code and architecture when it matters, and you believe the best security organizations earn their influence through partnership rather than policy enforcement.

Our Security Philosophy

We run security the way the best engineering-led companies do:

Security reduces toil. Our job is to make the rest of the company faster and safer at the same time. If a control adds friction without reducing risk, it is a defect.
Paved paths, safe by default. We invest in guardrails, golden paths, and secure-by-default infrastructure so the easy choice is the secure choice. We prefer preventing classes of problems over chasing individual findings.
Partnership over gatekeeping. Security succeeds only through deep collaboration with engineering, IT, and business teams. We embed with builders, we ship alongside them, and we take on their constraints as our own.
Engineering-grade rigor. We treat security problems as engineering problems: automated, measurable, code-reviewed, and continuously improved.

If the security cultures that value freedom and responsibility, context over control, and guardrails over gates resonate with you, you will feel at home here.

What You Will Do

Serve as deputy to the CISO: act with full authority in the CISO's absence and represent the security organization to executives, customers, and regulators.
Lead, coach, and grow managers and senior engineers across Security Engineering and Security Operations.
Own the security engineering roadmap: cloud security architecture (AWS-first), detection and response, identity, vulnerability management, and secure-by-default platform investments.
Drive cross-functional programs with Engineering, IT, and Product, from AI security governance to data perimeter controls to federal compliance initiatives.
Set and defend engineering standards for the security organization: everything as code, automated where possible, measured against outcomes rather than activity.
Build hiring pipelines and raise the bar on every hire; own performance management, promotion cases, and succession planning within your teams.
Translate technical risk into business terms for the executive team and board, and translate business priorities into a coherent security strategy.

Must Haves

10+ years in security or software engineering, including 4+ years managing security teams, ideally including managers of managers or equivalent scope.
A genuine software engineering background: you have shipped production software, and you evaluate security solutions the way an engineer would.
A proven record of building and scaling high-performing security teams, with alumni who would work for you again.
Deep technical fluency in cloud-native environments: AWS organizations and multi-account governance, Kubernetes, identity and access, detection engineering, and modern SDLC security.
Demonstrated cross-functional leadership: you have earned the trust of engineering leaders and shipped security outcomes through their teams, not around them.
Strong written communication: you produce decision-ready documents and can drive alignment asynchronously.
Executive presence: comfortable presenting to C-level leadership, customers, and auditors without preparation from the CISO.

Strong Signals

You are currently a security engineering manager or senior manager at a fintech, high-growth startup, or forward-leaning enterprise, and you are ready for broader scope.
You have built paved-path or secure-by-default platforms that measurably reduced both risk and developer friction.
Experience with compliance-driven environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) without letting compliance define the security program.
Experience securing AI/ML systems or governing AI adoption at scale.
You have operated in environments where security headcount was scarce and automation was the only way to scale.

Why This Role

You will inherit strong teams, an executive staff that treats security as a first-class function, and a CISO who wants a true partner rather than a lieutenant. The scope is broad, the autonomy is real, and the ceiling on this role is defined by what you take on.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:

$214,200—$308,000 USD

A note on AI in our process:

Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

Description

Come help us build the worlds most personal and proactive AI assistant with Alexa+. With over 600 million Alexa devices now out in the world, the latest advancements in generative AI have unlocked new possibilities—enabling us to reimagine the personal communication experience in our pursuit of making customers' lives better and easier every day.

Our vision at Alexa Connections is to build the most trusted AI assistant that helps our customers gets things done and creates moments of joy. We build delightful Communication Experiences for connecting within customers household (Announcements, Drop-In's), with their community (Video Calling, Phone Number calling, Emailing, Texting, Sharing) and with AI for improved productivity (Calendar/Task extraction). We also build real time multi-modal AI primitives that help serve customers across Amazon portfolio of devices that include Alexa, FireTV, Ring etc. Generative AI is deeply embedded in our product development life cycle across all our experiences and primitives.

If you’re passionate about building magical experiences for customers, while solving complex technical problems, then this role is for you. You will operate at the intersection of large language models, real time communications, voice and graphical user interfaces, and mixed reality to deliver delightful experiences for end customers.

Come join us to invent the future of how billion's of customers will connect with and through their virtual AI assistants.

Key job responsibilities

As the Sr Manager of Software Development, you will be responsible for leading a large yet scrappy team that invents and simplifies daily. Your team will build the delightful consumer facing UX, Alexa's communication systems, interface with third party telecom infra and optimize Alexa's LLM architecture to help Connections achieve its vision. You will coordinate the implementation efforts between internal and external partners. You will make appropriate trade offs to optimize time-to-market with long term tech evolution. You will optimize your organization to maximize the value for our customers. You will clearly communicate strategy, optimize roles & responsibilities, and achieve desired outcomes. You will influence the forward looking strategy for Alexa+, our portfolio of devices and services. You will be an integral part of Alexa Connections Executive team.

Alexa Connections is a highly distributed team across six Amazon approved sites. We have industry experts in real time communications, computer vision, media processing, consumer facing UX. We imbibe Amazon's Leadership Principles, hold each other accountable and have lots of fun while building a product billions of our users love. You will constantly help us foster a culture where everyone can do their best work.

10+ years of engineering experience
5+ years of engineering team management experience
Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Experience communicating with senior business, product, design and engineering executives; inspiring teams on a delightful technical strategy

Deep knowledge of real time communications and collaboration, networking, computer vision, multi-modal AI technologies
