About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

About the Role

The CTO will own technology for doit Holdings, our regulated investment platform in Malaysia. This is a build role. The platform does not exist yet, and it has to be built inside a technology risk framework that satisfies the Securities Commission's Guidelines on Technology Risk Management from the first line of code. The role runs from architecture and engineering execution through to the systems evidence the SC assesses at registration.

What you will be doing

Own architecture and major technical decisions for the platform, from onboarding and order routing through records, reporting and the partner interfaces.
Build and lead the engineering team, and set standards across reliability, security, performance, testing and code quality.
Implement the SC's technology risk requirements as engineering practice: change control and approvals, secure development, testing and acceptance, capacity and resilience.
Produce the systems evidence behind the readiness declaration a director and the Responsible Person must sign before the platform may operate.
Take the platform through the independent technology validation that gates registration, and close what it finds.
Own business continuity and disaster recovery, tested rather than documented.
Own cloud, vendor and outsourcing arrangements, where the board remains accountable for everything outsourced.

What you will need

Deep software engineering background with experience building and scaling production systems.
Strong knowledge of backend systems, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
Experience making architecture decisions across multiple products or engineering teams.
Strong technical judgement and ability to challenge engineering decisions at implementation level.
Capable of building world-class engineering teams.
Still technically hands-on - able to review code, architecture, incidents and difficult engineering problems directly.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Technical interview
3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Job Description Summary

The Head of Industrial Engineering & Operational Strategy will lead the development and execution of manufacturing optimization initiatives across the organization. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence, productivity improvement, cost competitiveness, capacity planning, and strategic transformation projects. Partnering closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, and Plant Leadership teams, this leader will shape the long-term operational strategy while ensuring world-class manufacturing performance.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the Industrial Engineering and Operational Strategy roadmap aligned with business objectives.
Lead productivity, efficiency, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.
Drive workforce optimization, labor standards, plant capacity planning, and resource utilization strategies.
Implement Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and Industry 4.0 initiatives to improve performance and competitiveness.
Develop data-driven approaches for operational decision-making, KPI management, and performance optimization.
Partner with plant leadership teams to identify opportunities for cost reduction, quality improvement, and operational scalability.
Lead manufacturing footprint assessments, investment evaluations, and strategic operational projects.
Build, develop, and mentor high-performing Industrial Engineering and Operations Excellence teams.

Required Skills And Education

Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Management, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
Proven leadership experience in Industrial Engineering, Operational Excellence, Continuous Improvement, or Manufacturing Strategy within complex manufacturing environments.
Strong expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping, Workforce Planning, and Productivity Improvement methodologies.
Demonstrated success leading large-scale operational transformation and cost optimization initiatives.
Strong analytical, financial, and project management capabilities with a data-driven decision-making approach.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership.
Advanced English proficiency required.
